Following the execution path, we find that `get_xlim()` method in `Axes` class returns `(0.7, 0.3)` instead of `(1, 0)`, which is expected.

The code snippet for `get_xlim()` method shows that it simply returns `tuple(self.viewLim.intervalx)`. This suggests that the issue lies in how `invert_xaxis()` method changes the x-axis limits, because after calling this method, `get_xlim()` still returns the original limits instead of the inverted ones.
